bullets.title: AVGO: Down 13-15% AH/Pre-Market on AI Semis Guide Miss; Consensus Bullish Dip-Buy
bullets.body: Broadcom beat Q2 FY26 revenue ($22.19B vs $22.13B est) and EPS ($2.44 vs $2.40), but Q3 AI semiconductor guide of $16B missed elevated buy-side expectations (~$17-17.5B); FY26 AI revenue reaffirmed at ~$56B and FY27 at >$100B with 10GW shipment target—no raise despite $30B+ in bookings. Macquarie downgraded to Neutral ($437 PT); majority of sell-side (Citi $500, Wolfe $500, UBS $485, KeyBanc $575, Oppenheimer $535, RBC $400, Mizuho $530) see the pullback as a buying opportunity citing FY28 ramp visibility and Anthropic (>1GW '26, 5GW '27+), OpenAI (1.3GW '27), Meta (3GW '28), and Apollo/Blackstone 20GW+ platform.

bullets.title: CRWD: Light ARR Beat but FY27 Raise Impresses; 4-for-1 Split Announced
bullets.body: CrowdStrike Q1 FY27 revenue $1.386B (+26% YoY, beat consensus), net new ARR $256M beat but below buy-side $275M expectation—smallest beat magnitude since Q2 FY24. FY27 ARR guidance raised $53-57M to $6.532-6.556B midpoint (+24-25% growth); AIDR pipeline grew 250% QoQ with $50M+ opportunity. Stock announced 4-for-1 split (record June 25). Cantor raised PT to $725, DA Davidson $765, KeyBanc $745, RBC $755, Mizuho $700, Roth $785; Citi reiterates Buy at $780. Stock fell ~10% AH after 65-70% run in prior 30-45 days.

bullets.title: CIEN: Strong Q2 Beat and FY26 Raise Overshadowed by OpEx Hike; Stock -8%
bullets.body: Ciena Q2 EPS $1.64 vs $1.46 consensus; revenue $1.57B vs $1.50B; FY26 guidance raised to $6.2-6.4B from $5.9-6.3B. However, Q3 OpEx unexpectedly raised +6.5% to $410M and FY26 OpEx +5.5% to $1.61B, limiting estimate upgrades. Stock down 8-9% driven partly by AVGO-related sector weakness. JPM notes beat quality strong but OpEx hike offsets revenue/margin gains.

bullets.title: AVGO Read-Through: Semis Broadly Down 5-10% Pre-Market
bullets.body: AVGO's AI guide miss cascades into sector: MU -7.2%, ARM -7.1%, MRVL -6.7%, AMD -4%, ANET -6.7%, CIEN -8.9%. SMH semiconductor index had been up 99% over 45 days prior; Jefferies notes tactical take-profit risk after the two-month rally. Key networking names (ANET, CIEN, CRDO) down 6-9.5%.

bullets.title: PLTR: Google Cloud Partnership and Anthropic Differentiation Are Bullish Catalysts
bullets.body: Palantir announced a multi-tiered partnership with Google Cloud including two-way BigQuery-Foundry data federation, Marketplace availability, and semantic exchange between Knowledge Catalog and Foundry Ontology. OPCO notes PLTR's Ontology platform is complementary to—not competitive with—Anthropic, dominating complex customized workloads while Anthropic handles simpler automation; PLTR is model-agnostic across all LLMs. Stock up 2% pre-market on Google partnership.

bullets.title: ROKU: Morgan Stanley Raises PT to $170 on New Home Screen Engagement Catalyst
bullets.body: MS reiterates Overweight on ROKU, raising PT from $150 to $170 (bull case $200). New home screen rolling out to ~20% of base; platform revenue growth raised ~200bps with '27 mid-teens growth expected on improving ad margins (+450bps to >60%) and subscription ARR ($2B, +30% YoY). DSP integration with Amazon/Google DV360 drove programmatic spend +40% YoY in Q1. Line of sight to $1B FCF by 2028.

bullets.title: SNOW: Wolfe Bullish Post-Summit; CoCo AI Driving Consumption Acceleration
bullets.body: Wolfe reiterates Outperform on SNOW ($310 PT, 15x CY27E EV/Sales, 28.5% upside) after Summit 2026. CoCo AI agent used by 61% of surveyed customers, 82% expect AI workloads to increase consumption, migrations up 1.9x YoY and 40% faster. Management guides mid-30% product revenue growth in FY27, GAAP profitable by FY28, operating margin 13.5% vs 12.5% prior. Iceberg revenue tracking toward $300M by year-end. MS separately raised PT to $300.

bullets.title: NVDA: Kumo AI Acquisition for $400M+; Mizuho PT Raised to $300
bullets.body: NVIDIA acquired Kumo AI for enterprise foundation model capabilities focused on business predictions. Separately, Mizuho raised NVDA PT to $300. MS notes NVDA data center business projects >100% YoY growth this quarter with Vera Rubin CPU expected to maintain high GPU market share. Jensen Huang at Computex confirmed Foxconn mass-producing Vera Rubin compute trays at 1 per minute on fully automated lines; SK Hynix chairman and Jensen Huang met at GTC Taipei.

bullets.title: MRVL: Google TPUv8e Custom Networking Win on Intel 18A; NVDA CEO Praises Trillion-Dollar Potential
bullets.body: Marvell won a custom networking chip order from Google for the TPUv8e program, to be manufactured on Intel's 18A/18AP process. NVDA CEO Jensen Huang publicly praised Marvell's trillion-dollar potential in networking/connectivity. At BofA conference, MRVL projected data center revenue rising to 55% of mix, custom silicon to double in CY2026, with $8-10B custom silicon revenue target by 2028 and $300M scale-up optics revenue in 2027.

bullets.title: NET: Grok Deployed on Cloudflare; Morgan Stanley Raises PT to $305
bullets.body: xAI's Grok AI model is now deployed on Cloudflare's platform, expanding NET's AI workload footprint. Morgan Stanley raised PT from prior level to $305, noting upcoming Analyst Day as catalyst to clarify long-term margin framework and Edge AI/Agentic Web expansion opportunity.

bullets.title: GOOGL: $85B Equity Offering Closes Multiple Times Oversubscribed; AI Infrastructure Acceleration
bullets.body: Alphabet's equity offering closed multiple times oversubscribed and upsized from $80B to $85B, with Berkshire Hathaway participation viewed as a vote of confidence in AI strategy. Google announced major AI infrastructure deals: additional TPU capacity for Anthropic, Meta initial 1GW order starting 2027, and 20+ GW platform with Apollo and Blackstone through 2028. Ark Invest separately purchased 267,582 GOOGL shares.

bullets.title: META: Samsung Custom SoC Talks Suspended; Muse Spark API Delayed Again; $200/mo AI Agent Pricing
bullets.body: Korean media reports Samsung's custom SoC discussions with Meta have been temporarily suspended at Meta's request—deal potentially worth tens of billions. Separately, Meta has delayed Muse Spark AI API release again with no fixed date. Meta plans to charge up to $200/month for upcoming 'Hatch/OpenClaw' AI agent. Jensen Huang stated 'nobody uses AI better than Meta.'

bullets.title: EQIX/DLR: NAREIT Takeaways Bullish; AI/Inference Demand Drives Pricing Power
bullets.body: EQIX outperforming LT guidance with double-digit growth becoming new baseline; ~25% cash-on-cash returns on new contracts, disciplined capacity expansion doubling over 5 years, strong NPS and structurally low churn. DLR signed 200MW Charlotte inference lease (largest ever single lease), has ~6GW development pipeline 61% pre-leased with 11%+ yields. US data center vacancy sub-1%, supporting pricing power. MS maintains OW on both.

bullets.title: CLS: JPM Overweight—55% ODM Networking Share, 3-Year Demand Visibility, Margin Expansion
bullets.body: JPM reiterates Overweight on Celestica after management meetings. CLS holds 55% share in ODM Networking (top 2 vendors ~80% of market), largest 400G/800G Ethernet switching share. Customer order visibility extended to 3 years vs. historical ~1 year. CapEx at $1B in 2026 and $1.5B in 2027 supporting margin expansion of 60bps in 2026 despite gross margin headwinds. FCF growth (~9%) lags EPS (~70%) due to elevated capex.

bullets.title: NOW: Bullish Technical Setup; $1B+ Data/Analytics ARR Within Quarters
bullets.body: Multiple sources flag NOW showing higher-high and strong-volume reversal pattern after pullback. At Evercore TMT conference, NOW said it's on track to surpass $1B in data/analytics ARR within quarters, with Data World fully integrated and plans for dedicated analytics sales force in H2. Stock up 2-2.4% pre-market on software strength; one social trader trimmed 20% prior, plans to re-enter on dips.

bullets.title: HOOD: Director Meyer Malka Buys $35M+ in Shares Over One Week
bullets.body: HOOD Director Meyer Malka purchased $15.1M more shares through Bullfrog Capital, bringing total insider purchases over the past week to $35.1M—a significant bullish insider signal. Separately, one social account notes crypto price drops negatively impact HOOD; regulatory risk from proposed Clarity Act also flagged.

bullets.title: MDB: Wolfe Adds to Alpha List at $545 PT as Agentic AI Data Layer Play
bullets.body: Wolfe Research added MongoDB to its Alpha List ($545 PT, 48% upside), noting MDB is emerging as the multi-cloud, multi-model data layer for agentic AI with Atlas set for 2H takeoff as AI contribution accelerates. TWLO removed from the same list.

bullets.title: ORCL: Citi Raises PT to $330 on Accelerating Cloud/AI Bookings
bullets.body: Citi maintains Buy on ORCL, raising PT to $330. FQ4 IaaS strength expected with NNRPO closing in on $600B; FY27 EPS modestly above consensus, OCI CapEx guided ~$80B for FY27 (vs consensus ~$65B) driven by AI ramp. FY1Q Cloud guidance ~60% driven by AI OCI growth. ORCL earnings scheduled June 10.

bullets.title: HUBS: Above-Guide Q1; Agent Pricing Change Creates Near-Term ARR Headwind
bullets.body: HubSpot beat Q1 on revenue, operating margin, and net adds. Recent agent pricing changes (lower prices, outcome-based) create short-term ARR headwinds but unlock medium-term growth. 2026 operating margin guidance raised with further targets at September update. Internal AI adoption driving R&D productivity. Traditional search content leads down 27% YoY.

bullets.title: UBER: Commits ~$500M to Nuro; CEO Sees Autonomous Vehicles as Trillion-Dollar Marketplace
bullets.body: Uber participated in a $203M Nuro funding round at $6B valuation, bringing total Uber commitment to Nuro to ~$500M. CEO Dara Khosrowshahi at Invest Like the Best podcast highlighted AV as potential trillion-dollar marketplace for Uber as demand aggregator across 30+ AV partnerships; Uber One membership exceeded 50M with ~50% YoY growth.
